match_theorem_instances: match all instances of a single theorem rule against a geometry graph using match_one_theorem
forward_deduce_bfs_level: forward deduce one breadth-first search level of geometric facts using bfs_one_level
match_generic_theorem: match any generic theorem rule not in the built-in match functions using match_generic
run_algebraic_derivations: run algebraic derivations on added geometric dependencies using do_algebra and apply_derivations
cache_theorem_matches: cache theorem match results across a single BFS level using cache_match
